scope.description: Current mainnet BoostVoter and veBTC/veMEZO graph at the index block.

limitations: Contract mappings resolve to registry provenance review-accepted registry identities and activation histories; incentives evidence review accepted the bounded protocol model, but public reader and writer support remain absent.
Boost values depend on volatile deployed state and are not writer defaults.

roles.boostableAsset: veBTC receives the resulting voting-power multiplier
roles.target: One boost gauge may be associated with an eligible normal or managed veBTC NFT.

inputs.gaugeWeight: current boosted veMEZO voting weight allocated to the veBTC NFT's boost gauge
inputs.votingVeTotalWeight: current totalVotingPower of veMEZO, including any boost applicable to that voting escrow
inputs.boostableVeWeight: current unboostedVotingPowerOfNFT for the target veBTC NFT

formula.zeroCases: A missing gauge, zero total veMEZO power, or zero target unboosted veBTC power yields the default 1x factor.
formula.rounding: Each ratio floors before multiplication. Preserve the order and checked uint256 arithmetic used by the contract.

application.claim: pokeBoost or a boost-aware veBTC state transition asks BoostVoter for the current factor and checkpoints veBTC with that factor. The multiplier affects virtual/boosted voting power; it does not increase underlying locked BTC.
application.staleness: The stored veBTC boost changes only when updateBoost is invoked through a poke or a boost-aware escrow transition. A read-time formula result and stored checkpoint can therefore differ until an update.

independenceBoundaries: veMEZO ownership does not transfer ownership of the boosted veBTC NFT.
The boost is a voting-power multiplier, not a BTC reward or APY guarantee.
The formula uses global and target voting-power state, so boost is not a fixed conversion rate between veMEZO and veBTC.
